sections.title: Epic-wide:  today's spell epic
sections.description: The commands that act on a whole epic.  `spell epic <verb>` becomes `epic <verb>`, nothing else changes

sections.title: Epic page:  making and reading
sections.description: The epic page tool's verbs go straight under `epic`:  `spell dev plan-doc <verb>` becomes `epic <verb>`

sections.title: Epic page:  phases
sections.description: As above;  `request` is the one verb renamed

sections.title: Epic page:  items
sections.description: As above;  `details` keeps its name here

sections.title: Epic page:  the review inbox
sections.description: What Owen marks on the page, and how a review session takes it:  `epic inbox <epic> <what>`

sections.title: Pages Owen answers on, and comments
sections.description: Groups under `epic`:  details pages become `epic ask`, the rest keep their names

sections.title: Old spellings
sections.description: What keeps working during the move, and what goes

sections.title: Repo plumbing:  stays spell dev
sections.description: Not about epics:  docs, the design system, servers, windows, sessions, worktrees ... unchanged

sections.title: Goals:  parked
sections.description: P6 parked goals:  these commands go, rather than being renamed;  Goals Foundation builds new ones

sections.title: The spell language:  unchanged
sections.description: `spell` stays the language's own tool:  none of these change

rows.purpose: Sends a request to another epic's session, with Owen's words and screenshots, and wakes it. What /send runs when one session is asked to change something another epic owns.
rows.note: no epic named:  it goes to the tooling home epic

rows.purpose: Lists the requests other sessions sent to an epic, and which still wait. /epic request reads it to pick one up.
Marks a request as taken up; with a phase number, also writes it into that phase's Requests. Run when an epic accepts a request.
Says which epic is the tooling home, where requests about dev tooling go; with a name, sets it.
Merges a standing epic's finished phase into main without ending the epic. Run after each phase of a standing epic, like this one.
Starts a new epic page from the template and lists it in the docs. What /epic <name> runs first.
rows.note: --future:  an idea for later, not planned yet (/epic future)

rows.purpose: Lists every epic: its state, where it runs, and how many items wait for Owen's review. Used to pick an epic to review.
Prints where an epic stands: its open questions, issues, caveats and todos, and its next phase.
The same summary for several epic pages at once, as data. /epics runs it to list every open epic.
Lists an epic's items and their review state, e.g. only the ones Owen hasn't reviewed. What a review walks through.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc items seo --filter unreviewed

rows.purpose: Lists the docs an epic wrote or touched besides its epic page, and its changelog entry. /docs-check reads it.
rows.note: `spell dev docs` stays the docs tools

rows.purpose: Lists what an epic settled: finished phases, chosen options, answers. /docs-check uses it to make the docs match.
Shows an epic page in VS Code's right side bar.
Checks an epic page for broken ids, links and parts, then loads it in a headless browser. Run after editing a page.
Adds a phase to an epic page: its name, what's wrong, what changes. What /epic phase runs.
Rewrites part of a phase's plan: its goal, the files it changes, how to check it. Used when a phase's plan changes.
Adds a dated note to a phase's Plan changes, saying what changed in its plan and why, so Owen spots it.
Sets a phase's time estimate; the page's total follows.
Marks a phase to do, active or done; with --done, writes what was built. Run when a phase starts and when it ends.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc phase seo 3 done --done ...

rows.purpose: Makes an epic standing: never finished, each phase merging into main by itself. Set once, for a long-running epic like this one.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc standing epic-workflow on

rows.purpose: Writes a request another session sent into a phase's Requests. Run for you by epic file; rarely typed.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc request seo 7 r3 --from ... --file r3.html
rows.note: the one verb renamed:  next to `requests` and `file`, `request` reads like a third way to send;  `add-request` matches `add-phase`

rows.purpose: Lists a commit under a phase or an item, with a one-line summary. Run after committing a phase's work.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc commit seo abc123 --phase 3

rows.purpose: Finds every phase and item commit in git's history and lists them on the epic page. For older pages missing them.
Adds an item to an epic page: a question, judgement call, caveat, issue, todo or test. Run whenever Claude makes a call or finds a problem.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc add seo judgement "Title" --details ...

rows.purpose: Marks judgement calls or issues as not urgent: yellow on the page instead of red. For calls that wouldn't surprise Owen.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc calm seo J3 J4

rows.purpose: Answers a question on the epic page and marks the option chosen. Run once Owen has picked.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc decide seo Q3 "..." --option A

rows.purpose: Closes an item: a judgement call accepted, a test passed, an issue fixed.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc close seo J3

rows.purpose: Opens a closed item again.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc reopen seo J3

rows.purpose: Strikes out an item that another decision made moot, saying why.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc cancel seo J3 "why"

rows.purpose: Writes into an item: a reply to Owen's note, or more details under it. What every background agent answering a review note runs.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc details seo J3 --file reply.html --append
rows.note: keeps its name:  the most-run verb;  the details PAGES move to `epic ask` instead

rows.purpose: Puts Claude's status card on an item: underway (what Claude took the task to be), done, or noted. Owen sees it at once while reviewing.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc status seo J3 underway "..."
rows.note: the card on ONE item;  an epic's own state is `summary`

rows.purpose: Puts an item's earlier text back from git, into its folded Original Discussion. For text lost in a rewrite.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc original seo J3 --file old.html

rows.purpose: Marks an item reviewed today, with the outcome in the log. Run after talking an item over with Owen.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc review seo J3 "outcome"

rows.purpose: Puts an item off: still not reviewed, dated, so it comes up again later.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc defer seo J3

rows.purpose: Notes that an item's work waits for a later phase ("P14 · Goals Foundation"). Run when Owen sends an item to a phase.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc queue seo J3 "work"

rows.purpose: Takes that note off, once the work starts or is dropped.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc unqueue seo J3

rows.purpose: Shows what Owen left on an epic page for Claude: marks, notes, comments, and whether he sent them. The first thing a review checks.
Tells the epic page this session is reviewing it, so it stops saying nobody is. Run when a review starts.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc inbox seo listen

rows.purpose: Tells the page this session stopped reviewing. Run when a review ends.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc inbox seo unlisten

rows.purpose: Waits until Owen sends marks or comments from the page, then prints them and ends, which wakes the session. Run in the background during a review.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc inbox seo wait

rows.purpose: Applies Owen's quick marks to the page: approvals, picked options, new todos. Run after each send; prints what's left to talk over.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc inbox seo apply

rows.purpose: Turns an item's spinner on the page on or off, so Owen sees Claude is on it.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc inbox seo working J3 on
rows.recommended: epic inbox seo working J3 on

rows.purpose: Clears an item's request once it's answered, and stops its spinner.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc inbox seo done J3

rows.purpose: Drops Owen's marks on an item after talking it over, keeping his note on the page.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc inbox seo clear J3

rows.purpose: Adds a timestamped line to the epic page's log.
Sets the prompt that started the epic, shown folded in its Overview.
Starts or ends an overnight run: while on, every change stays highlighted until Owen reviews it. What /bedtime runs.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc bedtime seo start "P3-P6"

rows.purpose: Removes the old Overnight report section from pages written before 2026-10-05, once read. Rarely needed now.
rows.current: spell dev plan-doc overnight seo remove

rows.purpose: Marks items Owen already went through in past sessions as reviewed, from the session records. A dry run unless --apply; for older epics.
Rewrites an epic page from the old markup into today's, as a copy, proving nothing was lost. Only for a page restored from an old backup.
Stores an epic page as a short skeleton plus one file per phase or item, loaded when opened. New pages start that way already.
Splits every finished epic that has no worktree. A one-time tidy.
Puts a split epic page back into one file.
Makes a details page: a question Claude explains with pictures and option cards, which Owen answers on the page. What /details runs.
rows.note: `details` is taken by the verb that writes into an item;  `ask`:  Claude asks, Owen answers on the page

rows.purpose: Shows a details page in VS Code's side bar, then waits for Owen's answer.
Waits in the background until Owen answers a details page, then prints the answer, which wakes the session.
Prints the answer Owen already sent on a details page.
Lists the details pages: answered, or still waiting.
Deletes scratch details pages older than 14 days; an epic's own pages are kept.
Makes a choices page like this one: a row per name, Claude's pick filled in, Owen types over the ones he'd change.
rows.current: spell dev choices new epic-cli --rows rows.json --epic seo
rows.recommended: epic choices new epic-cli --rows rows.json --epic seo

rows.purpose: Shows a choices page in VS Code's side bar, then waits for Do it.
Waits in the background until Owen presses Do it, then prints what he changed.
Prints what Owen already sent from a choices page.
Lists the choices pages: answered, typed but not sent, or waiting.
Lists the comments Owen left with the bullhorn on guides that still wait for Claude.
Takes every waiting comment on the guides into one epic, guide-changes, a phase per page. /airplane land runs it.
Shows "Claude: thinking…" on a comment's thread while Claude works on it.
rows.current: spell dev comments working guides/x.html cm3 on
rows.recommended: epic comments working guides/x.html cm3 on

rows.purpose: Puts Claude's answer on a guide comment's thread, for Owen to close or reply to.
rows.current: spell dev comments answer guides/x.html cm3 --file r.html
rows.recommended: epic comments answer guides/x.html cm3 --file r.html

rows.purpose: Lists the page notes Owen left on guides before comments replaced them.
Writes Claude's answer under one of those old page notes.
rows.current: spell dev notes answer guides/x.html n3 --file r.html
rows.recommended: epic notes answer guides/x.html n3 --file r.html

rows.purpose: Marks an old page note done.
rows.current: spell dev notes done guides/x.html n3

rows.purpose: Lists the background agents running for this epic, and what each is doing.
rows.note: the root CLAUDE.md's rule for every session names these

rows.purpose: Puts a background agent on the running list, with its name and task, before it starts. Every session does this for each agent.
Updates an agent's status line on that list.
Takes an agent off the list when it's back.
Waits in the background for Owen's notes redirecting a running agent, sent from the epic page's Agents panel.
Marks Owen's redirect note as passed on to its agent.
Says whether airplane mode is on: Owen working on the docs with no Claude, everything queued.
Turns airplane mode on: pages say that what Owen leaves waits until he lands. What /airplane runs before a flight.
Turns airplane mode off.
Checks that the pages Owen needs work offline, and fixes what it can. Run before a flight.
Gathers everything Owen left while offline, across every epic and page.
Today's spelling of the epic-wide commands. Keeps working, running epic, until no caller is left.
Today's spelling of every epic page command. Keeps working as another name for epic <verb> until the tidy.
rows.note: the same for details, choices, comments, notes, agents and airplane

rows.purpose: An older spelling, deprecated already. Goes: nothing runs it any more.
The yarn shortcut for the epic page commands, renamed to match. The old name stays beside it until the tidy.
The yarn shortcut for details pages, renamed to match epic ask.
Rebuilds the docs' copy of Spell UI, re-lists every page, then checks every page's links and look. Run after changing Spell UI or the docs tools.
Rewrites the docs home's cards and each area's list of pages. Run after adding, renaming or retitling a page.
Starts a docs page from a template (a write-up, a cheat sheet, a command list) and lists it.
Shows a docs page in Chrome, or in VS Code's side bar.
Prints the two links Claude gives for a page: VS Code's side bar, then the browser.
Lists writing that's hard to read in comments and docs: dense paragraphs, banned words, lines split mid-phrase. What /fussbudget runs.
Lists what docs pages fetch from the internet, so they work offline; --fix points them at local copies.
Writes the files of Spell's design system on claude.ai, from Spell UI's components.
Bundles Spell UI into the one script Claude Design loads.
Checks that bundle in a headless browser, the way Claude Design loads it.
Brings a Claude Design board back as a docs page. What /design pull runs.
Lists what changed in the design system since its last push to claude.ai.
Records that the design system was pushed to claude.ai.
Says when the design system was last pushed, and whether it's current.
Runs this checkout's page server in the foreground, until Ctrl-C.
rows.note: the VS Code extension runs `server stop` and `ensure`

rows.purpose: Starts this checkout's page server in the background: docs, epic pages, Spell UI's docs.
Starts every web server of this checkout (page server, editor, Spell UI) and prints their ports. What /spell-serve runs.
Starts the page server only if it isn't running, restarting it if its code changed since. What every opener runs.
Stops the page server, and the editor with it.
Says whether the page server is running, and on which port.
Prints a file's address on the page server.
Writes any missing VS Code window file, one per package, and brings the rest up to date.
Says which VS Code window this session runs in.
Adds a folder to this VS Code window. Avoided: the folder stays in the window's file after its worktree is gone.
Removes a folder added that way.
Shows a docs page in this window's right side bar (Spell Docs, or Review).
Rebuilds the side bar's page view from scratch, when it stops answering clicks.
Opens a worktree in a new VS Code window of its own, tinted.
Makes a worktree if needed, opens its window and starts a new Claude session there. For starting an epic from another epic's window.
Gives this window a colour scheme; with no name, lists them.
For a session moving into a worktree but staying in this window: titles it ⎇ <name> and tints it; --end puts both back.
Closes a worktree's window and deletes its file.
Moves this session into another window's editor tab when the turn ends. What /isolate runs for a new window.
Does that move. The turn-end hook runs it; never typed.
Recommends staying in this window or opening a new one when isolating, with its reasons.
Makes a component pack: a package of custom elements (like the epic-* ones) that pages load on demand.
Adds an element to a component pack, from templates.
Builds a component pack's catalog and its script.
Checks a component pack's built files are current.
Builds the bundles only the page server serves (Spell UI's docs site, the brand pages); --stale, only the out-of-date ones. The page server runs it as it starts.
Says whether those bundles are current, and why not.
Builds Spell's VS Code extension and installs it. Run after changing the extension, the runner or the language server.
Builds the extension's package only.
Installs the built extension into VS Code.
Lists every yarn script, spell command and skill, ticking the ones the commands page names.
rows.note: must learn to read the new epic program too

rows.purpose: Lists only the commands the commands page is missing, failing if there are any. Run after adding a command.
Lists recent Claude Code sessions and where each runs.
Finds a saved session by its title or its worktree.
Opens a saved session in VS Code's Claude panel. What /session runs.
Sets this session's title in the Claude panel. What /title runs.
Marks a finished session's title ✅.
Gives every session's title the icon its work calls for: 📅 future, 🚧 under way, ✅ merged.
Says which VS Code window a session runs in.
Sums up another session's transcript: what it was asked, and what it did. /wtf <name> reads it.
Lists the live sessions and the worktree each works in.
Says where one worktree stands: uncommitted or unmerged work, its epic, its sessions.
Merges main into this worktree's branch, rebuilding the generated files both sides changed. Always used instead of a bare git merge.
Lists parked work: the notes /park leaves.
Lists what /wait-for could wait on.
Waits until another session or worktree finishes. What /wait-for runs in the background.
Takes stock of everything open (worktrees, branches, sessions, parked work, epics), sorted into in process, hung and dead. What /worktrees runs.
Shows each checkout's links to the shared content (epic pages, guides ...) and the shared repo's uncommitted files.
rows.note: the shared-commit hook runs `commit` every turn;  the worktree hook runs `link`

rows.purpose: Creates the shared content repo beside the checkout. Done once.
Links a checkout's shared folders into the shared repo. Run after merging a change to the list of folders.
Commits the shared repo, one commit per epic or folder. The turn-end hook runs it every turn.
Moves an old worktree, made before the shared content existed, onto it.
Moves pages an old branch left in old places, and fixes links written for the old layout. Run after merging an old branch.
Checks that every citation and repo path in the house rules, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the skills still points at something real.
Lists the goal sets.
Picks the goal set the other goals commands work on.
Turns a short goal reference into its page.
Sums up a goal set: its open items.
Lists the thoughts on goal pages still waiting to be digested.
Makes a new goal set.
Makes a new goal topic page.
Adds an item to a goal page.
Closes a goal item.
Opens a closed goal item again.
Adds a line to a goal page's log.
Sets a goal item's status.
Jots a thought onto a goal page. What /goals-thought ran.
Marks a thought digested, with what came of it.
Rewrites the goal pages' lists.
Checks the goal pages.
Runs the old goals page server in the foreground.
Starts or stops the old goals page server.
Opens a goal page in a browser. What /goals-open ran.
Opens a goal page in VS Code's side bar. What /goals-open-vs ran.
Starts talking a goal set through with Owen. What /goals ran.
Works the waiting thoughts into their goal pages. What /goals-update ran.
Starts a Claude session from a goal page's button.
An older spelling of the goals commands.
The yarn shortcut for the goals commands.
Compiles spell projects to JavaScript, or prints one file's compiled code.
Lists a project's errors, one per line, failing if there are any.
Shows what a file or project declares, as the Type Explorer does, or everything about one thing in it.
Opens the Type Explorer full screen, to browse what a project declares.
Compiles a project and runs it; one with a UI opens in the browser.
Runs a project's tests, reporting each pass or fail.
Recompiles projects whenever their files change, showing their errors.
Tidies the spacing in .spell files, as VS Code's Format Document does.
Lists the project roots, or the projects in one.
Times the parser's rule tests, optionally against an older commit.
Shows how spell reads one line: how it matched, then the JavaScript it becomes.
Like parse, a line at a time, each line knowing what the earlier ones declared.
Says what a word means to spell: the rules it names or starts.
Makes a new spell project: its project file and a starter .spell file.
Runs the spell app, editor and server, and opens it.
Finds Spell UI icons by name or keyword.
Turns ui-* pages into plain HTML, for search engines and readers without JavaScript.
Draws a pony in Spell's wizard hat, saying something.
Shows help, for spell or for one command.
